lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Good morning, and welcome back! I hope you're ready for another <color=red>adventure</color>.

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Last night I gave a little talk about <color=red>dinosaurs</color>, and now the whole camp is dinosaur-mad!

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: By breakfast, every single dinosaur book had been <color=red>borrowed</color>. Not one has come back.

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: I'm afraid my dinosaur shelf is now as <color=red>extinct</color> as a Tyrannosaurus!

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Barnaby, Tilly and Gus each need a hand with something today. Would you go and <color=red>visit</color> them?

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Help all three, and I'm sure my books will come <color=red>thundering</color> home like a herd of Triceratops.

inProgressLines.speaker: Mr. Page
inProgressLines.text: The dinosaur shelf is still looking rather <color=red>lonely</color>, I'm afraid.

inProgressLines.speaker: Mr. Page
inProgressLines.text: Keep helping Barnaby, Tilly and Gus, then come back once you've <color=red>finished</color>.

completeLines.speaker: Mr. Page
completeLines.text: Great galloping Stegosaurus, the shelves are <color=red>bursting</color> with dinosaur books!

completeLines.speaker: Mr. Page
completeLines.text: You helped every one of my friends. I'm absolutely <color=red>thrilled</color>!

completeLines.speaker: Mr. Page
completeLines.text: Thank you! You're a hero of truly <color=red>prehistoric</color> size.

afterLines.speaker: Mr. Page
afterLines.text: The dinosaur books are back where they <color=red>belong</color>. Pop in and read about them whenever you like!
